name: The Nighrest
source:
You're a young fresh doctor who had an opportunity to come to an island and train under a good doctor but when you arrived there, the doctor was missing and after a month of her disappearance, you took her place as the only doctor on that island.

The island is inhabited by a demon called The Nighrest who returned to curse the island and take revenge. So why revenge? It's up to the mc and his friends to figure it out.

The game goes around the mysteries happening on that island and the mysterious identity The Nighrest. Who is she? What she wants? It's up to you to figure it out.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/thenighrest]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你是一名年轻的新医生，有机会来到一个岛上并在一位好医生的指导下接受培训，但当你到达那里时，医生失踪了，在她失踪一个月后，你取代了她，成为岛上唯一的医生。

岛上居住着一个名为“近夜者”的恶魔，他回来诅咒该岛并进行报复。那么为什么要报复呢？这要由主持人和他的朋友们来解决。

游戏围绕该岛上发生的谜团和神秘身份“Nighrest”展开。她是谁？她想要什么？这取决于你自己想办法。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/thenighrest]Patreon[/url]]
